source: TwinLedger master specification §14.4; organizer limits unpublished (Q-009).

semantics.budget: Deterministic inspection steps, not wall clock. Wall clock is only a watchdog and never truncates an episode silently (§14.8).
semantics.truncated: Produced only by exhausting the deterministic budget, never by a timeout.
semantics.notes: If organizers publish different limits, only this file and adapter/compatibility.py change; env code reads the values from here.
